prompt: Vertical 9:16 night photograph from low on a taxi's back seat, looking out the open door, 50mm at f/1.4. A drunk lad, early twenties, short dark hair, untucked white going-out shirt, flushed and sweaty, tumbles towards the lens, lanyard of keys spinning off his fingers. In the doorway, leg still raised, a figure in a balaclava and white science lab coat. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. Yellow TAXI sign light on the door frame, inky blacks, amber and cyan bokeh. Thanks.
